title: 第298章 我要搬进山洞
slug: 极寒末世我有空间囤货躺平
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

周凛被这不要脸的言论气笑了，他按了按发胀的额头：

“不想废话，抓紧滚吧。”

要说打仗，周凛经验多的是，可天天和这群脑残扯皮，他是真头疼。

当初接任务建庇护所，是为了护佑受难的百姓，也没人告诉他还要碰上这糟烂的事啊！

“赶我们走？实话告诉你，周凛，你一开始接纳了我们就要对我们负责，这次回来，我们就是要搬进山洞里住的！”

田曼琪理直气壮，声音铿锵有力。

站在他身后的人都不自觉挺直了身板，有这么个话事人，真是倍儿有面子。

他们要搬进山洞里住？

这可真是强盗一般，林雪心里想。

她道：“从你们当初离开下洼村庇护所的那一刻，就跟我们毫无关系了。庇护所没有你们的容身之处，也绝对不会再接纳你们！”

林雪的话说得异常笃定，她有责任心，愿意帮助受难的人们，可这群人，就是死在她面前，她都不会救。

“你说这些话良心不会痛吗？我们可都是平民百姓，庇护所有义务保护我们。我们只是做错了选择，又不是坏人。”

后半句话，田曼琪转过了身，她眼含热泪，是对着身后众人说。

跟着田曼琪身后的几十人，听了这话均是眼眶一酸。

他们能有什么错？他们不过是有点自私，想寻求更好的生路罢了。

洞里的人们知道是那些闹着离开又灰头土脸回来的田曼琪等人后，知道没有危险，捧着饭碗站在门口吃饭看热闹。

曹阳咽下口中的食物，

“别煽情了，还整个做错了选择，你们骂人骂的多恶心，忘了吗？诅咒公益性的庇护所遭报应，多恶毒啊！这还不算坏人？庇护所不可能要你们了！”

曹阳的声音越来越大，一吆喝起来，所有人都能听见。

山洞里的人们跟着哄笑起来。

“你！”

田曼琪被怼的哑口无言，指着曹阳说不出来话。

她的视线从曹阳的脸上移到他的碗里。

干白菜汤，杂粮饭……

不仅仅是他，站在山洞外面看热闹的人们都捧着饭碗，那香味像是长了脚一样，一个劲地往鼻孔里钻。

她们已经很久没吃过一顿饱饭了，更何况是这么像样的饭菜。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Zhou Lin laughed angrily at the shameless remarks and pressed his swollen forehead:

"If you don't want to talk nonsense, hurry up and get out."

When it comes to fighting, Zhou Lin has more experience, but fighting with these idiots every day gives him a real headache.

When he accepted the mission to build the shelter, it was to protect the suffering people, and no one told him that he would have to encounter such a bad thing!

"Driving us away? To tell you the truth, Zhou Lin, you will be responsible for us as soon as you accept us. This time when you come back, we will move into a cave!"

Tian Manqi was confident and her voice was sonorous and powerful.

The people standing behind him straightened their bodies unconsciously. It was really a great honor to have such a talkative person.

Are they moving into a cave?

This is really like a robber, Lin Xue thought to herself.

She said: "From the moment you left the Xiawa Village shelter, you had nothing to do with us. The shelter has no place for you, and we will never accept you again!"

Lin Xue's words were extremely firm. She was responsible and willing to help people who were suffering, but she would not save these people even if they died in front of her.

"Don't your conscience hurt when you say these words? We are all civilians, and the shelter has the obligation to protect us. We just made the wrong choice, and we are not bad people."

In the second half of the sentence, Tian Manqi turned around, with tears in her eyes, and spoke to the people behind her.

The dozens of people following Tian Manqi all had sore eyes after hearing this.

What could they have done wrong?They are just a little selfish and want to find a better way to survive.

When the people in the cave knew that it was Tian Manqi and others who left in a fuss and came back disgraced, they knew that there was no danger, so they stood at the door with their rice bowls in hand to eat and watch the fun.

Cao Yang swallowed the food in his mouth,

"Stop being sensational, and you made the wrong choice. Have you forgotten how disgusting you are with the curses? It's so vicious to curse a public welfare shelter for retribution! Isn't this considered a bad person? There is no way the shelter will want you!"

Cao Yang's voice became louder and louder, and when he shouted, everyone could hear it.

The people in the cave started laughing.

"You!"

Tian Manqi was speechless and pointed at Cao Yang, unable to speak.

Her eyes moved from Cao Yang's face to his bowl.

Dried cabbage soup, multigrain rice...

Not only him, but the people standing outside the cave watching the excitement were all holding their rice bowls, and the scent seemed to have grown legs, constantly entering their nostrils.

It had been a long time since they had had a full meal, let alone such a decent meal.
